correctness.rationale: Direct basis-triple computation gives the pseudo-Hessian cocycle condition 2B11=0. Direct basis-pair computation gives Nijenhuis torsion 2c^2=2bc=2b(a-d)=0. Combining B-selfadjointness with the B1 cocycle gives exactly the displayed source family when 2 is invertible. In characteristic two the cocycle and torsion equations vanish, leaving precisely nondegenerate symmetric B and invertible B-selfadjoint N. Exact finite-field counts follow from determinant and kernel-line counts and are replayed by the packaged checker.

value.rationale: Pseudo-Hessian-Nijenhuis structures are a central geometric construction of the primary source, and Example 6.3 is its first explicit low-dimensional model. The result both proves the displayed characteristic-zero family exhaustive and identifies a sharp characteristic-two enlargement by an exact factor q^2 in the finite-field count. The intrinsic selfadjoint description and zeta functions provide natural moduli information rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
